fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of the builtin "copy" command that targets a shadow copy (sometimes used to copy registry hives that are in use)
fields.name: Copy From VolumeShadowCopy Via Cmd.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "copy " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\\\?\\GLOBALROOT\\Device\\HarddiskVolumeShadowCopy"))
